# `rewind`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] rewind`

End an active `checkpoint` by dropping exploratory conversation after the mark and keeping `report`. Files are not reverted.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `report` | string | yes | Concise findings to keep after collapsing the investigation |
